entries.content: Metropolitan areas with populations over 500,000 see an average of 3.2 million vehicle interactions per day at major intersections. Lane change frequency in urban cores is approximately 4x higher than in rural areas, with the average commuter changing lanes 12-15 times per mile in congested conditions.

Just venting - got pulled over on my way to work Tuesday. Officer said he'd been behind me for three blocks. $150 fine plus points on my license. Didn't even realize I was doing anything wrong since it's just how I've always driven. Expensive lesson about how much more enforcement there is here compared to where I grew up.
